answer: A head enters by posting a thread of three judged microtasks; admission needs signatures from a cut of nebula branches larger than the number of live heads already folded to that thread’s signer set. Each signing branch locks 1 ember behind the new head and loses it if two backed threads merge. First head: 3 branches, 3 ember. An operator’s kth head needs k+2 fresh branches and k+2 ember; n clones need n(n+5)/2 disjoint branches and ember, since reused branches collapse the set.
